source: U.S. Government Accountability Office, Critical Legacy IT Systems: Agencies Need to Address Modernization Challenges
claim_supported: Federal modernization requires attention to aging systems and disposition of legacy systems.
risk_notes: Government systems are unusually visible; do not generalize every cost estimate to private industry.

source: U.S. Government Accountability Office, Technology Modernization Fund: Improved Oversight Needed to Better Achieve Project Objectives
claim_supported: Modernization programs continue to target aging federal IT and expected savings.
risk_notes: Use for current context, not as proof that every modernization project produces savings.

source: OECD, Reviewing the Stock of Regulation
claim_supported: Sunset and review mechanisms exist to identify regulations that are redundant, outdated, or no longer cost effective.
risk_notes: Sunsets can create review overload or continuity risk; include counterevidence.

source: European Commission, What data can we process and under which conditions?
claim_supported: GDPR principles include data minimisation and storage limitation.
risk_notes: Retention may still be required by law or justified purpose.

source: European Data Protection Board, CEF 2025: Implementation of the right to erasure
claim_supported: Operational execution of erasure rights creates recurring implementation challenges.
risk_notes: Do not imply erasure is absolute; exceptions and competing obligations exist.

source: NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2, Guidelines for Media Sanitization
claim_supported: Sanitization is a lifecycle operation intended to render access to target data infeasible.
risk_notes: Distinguish sanitization from ordinary logical deletion and from every retention decision.

source: M. Fard et al., On the spread and evolution of dead methods in Java open-source software systems, Empirical Software Engineering
claim_supported: Empirical study connects dead code with maintainability and comprehensibility concerns and tracks dead methods over repository history.
risk_notes: Dead-code detection has limits; unused does not always mean safely removable.

source: Tomás J. Ryan and Paul W. Frankland, Forgetting as a form of adaptive engram cell plasticity, Nature Reviews Neuroscience
claim_supported: Forgetting can be understood in part as adaptive neuroplasticity rather than simple memory failure.
risk_notes: Analogy only; never use neuroscience as direct justification for deleting institutional records.
